sections.title: Functions of the colon
sections.subtitle: Absorption, gut flora, and natural elimination
sections.imageAlt: After colon hydrotherapy — cleansed healthy colon
sections.summary: Your colon plays a major role in hydration, digestion, gut flora balance, and natural elimination. When it’s functioning well, it supports comfortable digestion and better nutrient use.

topics.heading: What the colon does
bullets: Absorbs water and electrolytes to help keep the body hydrated
Supports digestion of remaining food with help from beneficial bacteria (gut flora)
Helps produce and support nutrients tied to gut bacteria activity (e.g., vitamins)
Forms and stores stool for regular elimination

topics.heading: Gut flora and wellness
bullets: Balanced gut flora supports digestion, comfort, and immune resilience
Imbalanced flora can contribute to bloating, irregular bowel movements, and discomfort
Diet, hydration, stress, and professional guidance can support healthier gut balance

topics.heading: Why this matters for your care
bullets: Colon hydrotherapy is an in-clinic, drug-free wellness service focused on natural elimination support
Our practitioner can help you decide if colon hydrotherapy is appropriate for your symptoms and goals
Book a free check-up to discuss your digestive wellness plan

sections.title: When waste builds up
sections.subtitle: Comfort, toxins, and digestive slowdown
sections.imageAlt: Before colon hydrotherapy — congested colon with accumulated waste
sections.summary: When bowel movements are irregular, waste can stay longer in the colon. This may contribute to discomfort, bloating, and a feeling of heaviness. Our clinic focuses on safe, hygienic, practitioner-guided care.

topics.heading: Common factors that can contribute
bullets: Low fiber intake, low water intake, or dehydration
Gut flora imbalance and digestive sensitivity

topics.heading: When to consult us
bullets: Constipation, bloating, or irregular bowel movements
Frequent gas, abdominal discomfort, or heaviness
If you want to know whether colon hydrotherapy is appropriate for you
